Current projects

roadkilltshirts.com

ShopifyE-commerce, funny graphic teesCornelius, NC, United StatesCurrent project

Goal

Grow organic traffic and sales for a US online store selling funny screen printed T-shirts, hoodies and aprons, and get the brand named when buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.

Challenges

A large catalog with many collections that can create thin or overlapping pages, seasonal demand spikes, strong competition from big print on demand marketplaces, and custom printing hosted on a separate domain.

Clicks, 6 months vs previous
4.95K → 6.01K+21%
CTR, 6 months vs previous
0.3% → 1.6%+433%

What I did

  • Collection SEO: keyword research and unique copy for category, theme and holiday collections, so each page targets a different intent.
  • Product pages: titles, descriptions, image alt text and internal links for best sellers and new designs.
  • Shopify health: canonicals for variants, pagination and filter URLs, duplicate content, sitemaps, redirects and page speed.
  • Product, Offer, Review and Breadcrumb schema for rich results.
  • AEO and GEO: FAQ blocks and answer first gift guides so the store can appear in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude.
  • Gift guides and topic content around humor, hobbies and family roles, plus a seasonal calendar planned ahead of peak periods.
  • Guest posts, link insertions and community presence on Reddit, Quora and niche forums, within Google spam policies.
  • Tracking clicks, impressions, CTR, positions and indexing in Search Console and GA4.

Frequently asked questions

Straight answers to what clients ask most before starting.

Traffic and visibility

My website is live but I am not getting traffic. Where do I start?

Check indexing in Google Search Console first. If pages are not indexed, nothing else matters yet. Then check that each page targets something people actually search for, and whether the site has any backlinks. I audit all three and give you the fixes in order of impact.

I have done SEO for months and still do not rank. Why?

Usual causes are keywords that are too competitive, thin or duplicate pages, technical blocks such as noindex or slow pages, and too few quality links. SEO often takes 3 to 6 months to show results, and longer in crowded niches.

I get traffic but no enquiries. What is wrong?

Often the traffic comes from the wrong keywords, such as people looking for information when you need buyers. I check which queries bring visitors, then tighten the pages that should convert.

Keywords and content

How do you choose keywords?

I start with what your customers type, check volume and competition in Ahrefs or SEMrush, look at what competitors rank for, and map one main keyword to each page so pages do not compete with each other.

Do you write the content too?

I write and review SEO content, and I brief writers with the structure, keyword mapping and internal links, then proofread before publishing.

Technical SEO and audits

Do you provide technical SEO audits?

Yes. I crawl the site with Screaming Frog, review Search Console and Core Web Vitals, and send a prioritized list of what to fix.

Can you fix the problems, or only report them?

I fix them. I build and maintain WordPress and Shopify sites, so speed, structure and indexing fixes do not have to wait for a developer.

E-commerce and links

My Shopify or WooCommerce products are not getting traffic. Can you help?

Usually the product and collection pages have thin or copied descriptions, weak titles and no internal links. I rewrite titles and descriptions, fix the structure and target category keywords. On the Saleemi Book Depot store, clicks rose 108% in six months.

Do you do link building?

Yes: outreach, guest posts, contextual links and listings. I check quality and relevance, vary the anchor text and track which links help.
